### Module(s)

all of the above

### Question

I'm a new Neovim user who is also a mini user via kickstart!

From the mini help docs, I can see that calling setup on a module creates a global camel-cased Lua object. My question is whether there is a best practice for removing the undefined global warning that I believe Lua LSP is giving me on that object. (e.g. line 2 diagnostic below says `Undefined global 'MiniIcons'.`)

`require('mini.icons').setup()
  MiniIcons.mock_nvim_web_devicons()`

I'm installing mini with lazy (kickstart default) if that is relevant. Thank you in advance.
